items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well he became his accompanist later on.

ctx.x: Well I don’t know except that he came up to our sessions and he also played for me at the North Park, which was open to all ages. He also played for me down on Rush Street. They had a 25th Anniversary of my promoting, and he was a guest, and he played there, along with the Pieces of Eight, which is an eight piece big little band, little big band. He was always very, very friendly. There’s a picture of us together that has been published around here and there. I never got in to talking about music that much with…
